instruction: Put a cleaned bar of soap on a counter.
videoNote: Original saved observations shown in order at uniform display intervals.
timingNote: Video playback and wall-clock trace time are separate.

steps.title: task context · observe · check success
steps.code:
import primitive_api as p

ctx = p.get_task_context()
print("CTX:", ctx)
obs = p.observe()
print("OBS:", obs)
print("SUCCESS:", p.check_success())

steps.title: scan scene · observe
steps.code:
import primitive_api as p

# Currently facing a shower wall. Turn around and scan for targets.
r = p.scan_scene(queries=["SoapBar","Sink","CounterTop"], rotations=4, include_tilts=True, remember=True)
print("hits:", r.get("query_hits"))
print("all_seen:", [o.get("objectType") for o in r.get("all_seen",[])])
print("pose:", p.observe()["agent"])

steps.title: locate object · observe
steps.code:
r = p.locate_object("SoapBar", aliases=["Soap","SoapBar"], support_queries=["CounterTop","Sink","SinkBasin"], search_budget=30, include_tilts=True, open_containers=True)
print("found:", r.get("found"), "visible_now:", r.get("visible_now"))
print("current:", r.get("current_object"))
print("candidates:", [(c.get("objectType"),c.get("objectId")) for c in r.get("candidates",[])])
print("pose:", p.observe()["agent"])

steps.title: pickup located object · query inventory
steps.code:
r = p.pickup_located_object("SoapBar", aliases=["Soap","SoapBar"], support_queries=["Toilet","CounterTop"], search_budget=20, open_containers=False)
print("ok:", r.get("ok"))
print("pickup:", r.get("pickup"))
print("inventory:", p.query_inventory())

steps.title: query inventory · list actions · query object state
steps.code:
print("ACTIONS:", p.list_actions())
inv = p.query_inventory()
print("inv:", [(o.get("objectType"), o.get("objectId")) for o in inv])
# state of soap and sink
print("soap state:", p.query_object_state("SoapBar"))
print("sink state:", p.query_object_state("SinkBasin"))

steps.title: approach object · scan scene
steps.code:
import primitive_api as p
# Turn to face the sink and look for a faucet
r = p.approach_object("Sink|-00.30|+00.80|+02.42|SinkBasin", max_steps=3, stop_distance=1.1)
print("dist:", round(r.get("final_distance",-1),2))
# scan for faucet / toggleables around
s = p.scan_scene(queries=["Faucet","Sink"], rotations=4, include_tilts=True, remember=True)
print("faucet hits:", s.get("query_hits",{}).get("Faucet"))
tog = [(o.get("objectType"),o.get("objectId"),o.get("toggleable")) for o in s.get("all_seen",[]) if o.get("toggleable")]
print("toggleables seen:", tog)
print("sinks seen:", [(o.get("objectType"),o.get("objectId")) for o in s.get("all_seen",[]) if "Sink" in (o.get("objectType") or "")])

steps.title: rotate · approach object · look
steps.code:
import primitive_api as p
# The sink vanity is on the left; turn left and approach, then look down
p.rotate("left")
p.approach_object("Sink|-00.30|+00.80|+02.42|SinkBasin", max_steps=4, stop_distance=0.9)
p.look("down")
objs = p.detect_objects()
print("view objs:", [(o.get("objectType"),o.get("objectId"),"T" if o.get("toggleable") else "") for o in objs])
print("progress:", p.check_progress_public()["goal_conditions_met"])
